Dangerous goods compliance, auditing and training

Consulting and auditing

We help transport, warehousing and manufacturing operators meet dangerous goods legislation without slowing their operations down. Our consultants audit current practice, identify the gaps against the regulations that apply to your cargo, and hand over a written remediation plan your team can act on immediately. An audit covers documentation, packaging, labelling, placarding, vehicle equipment and driver competence. We review consignment paperwork against the classification of the goods you actually move, inspect a representative sample of vehicles, and interview the staff responsible for loading and securing the load.

You receive a findings register ranked by risk, with the regulation each finding relates to and a practical correction for each one. Most operators close the majority of findings within a single quarter once that register exists, because the argument about what matters first has already been settled by the ranking.

Accredited training

Training runs at our centre or on your site. Courses cover classification, packing, marking and labelling, documentation, loading and segregation, and emergency response. Every delegate is assessed and certificated, and we keep a register so you can prove competence at a roadside inspection or a customer audit. We run refresher sessions timed to the renewal cycle so nobody on your team lapses without warning, and we can schedule sessions around shift patterns so a depot never loses a full day of capacity.

Booking enquiries go to training.bookings.department@example-compliance-group.co.za and we confirm within one working day.
